component.name: DyoSnap
component.summary: Screenshots and screen recordings, saved locally

description.p: A light screenshot and screen-recording app for Wayland desktops (GNOME, KDE Plasma). Every capture is saved on your computer and copied to the clipboard, so you can paste it right away.
Annotate screenshots in the built-in editor. Every change updates the clipboard. Videos stay crisp and small. No account, no cloud upload.

ul.li: Capture an area, a window or the whole screen
Record the screen as a video
Edit and annotate in the built-in editor
Everything is saved locally and copied to the clipboard

screenshot.caption: Annotate a screenshot in the editor
Capture an area, a window or the whole screen, or record a video

description.p: macOS: FFmpeg 9.1 is bundled and the microphone is found again. Updated dependencies.
macOS: the area to choose appears in about 0.1 s, and the recording bar stays clear of the Dock. Save and Copy now close the picture and video editors.

A crosshair and a loupe for choosing an area to the pixel, with position, size and colour. macOS: area screenshots in DyoSnap's own overlay, taken when the mouse is let go, and a faster switch between screenshot and recording.

Linux: signed apt and dnf repository for updates, one instance at a time, a window with a hint when there is no tray icon, SVG icon and AppStream metadata. macOS: open pictures and videos from the Finder.
Linux: .deb and .rpm packages, recording with OpenH264 when ffmpeg has no x264, and a new signing certificate on macOS.
Renamed from LightSnap to DyoSnap. Extra save folders with their own shortcuts and a tabbed Preferences window.
Many Linux improvements: area selection, a red frame around the record area, a recording control bar and a tray icon.
